---
title: "Paris Restaurant Recommendation System"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(shinydashboard)

# Load the dataset
load("cleaned_paris_restaurants.RData")

# UI
ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Paris Restaurant"),
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 18, 
      selectInput("cuisine_category", "Select Cuisine Category:", 
                  choices = c("All", unique(cleaned_paris_restaurants$cuisine_category)), 
                  selected = "All", width = '100%'),
      
      selectInput("cuisine_subcategory", "Select Cuisine Subcategory:", 
                  choices = c("All"), selected = "All", width = '100%'),
      
      selectInput("price_level", "Select Price Level:", 
                  choices = c("All", "€", "€€-€€€", "€€€€"), 
                  selected = "All", width = '100%'),
      
      sliderInput("rating", "Select Rating Range:", min = 0, max = 5, value = c(3, 5), step = 0.1, animate = TRUE, 
                  ticks = TRUE, dragRange = TRUE, label = "Select Rating Range", width = '100%'),
      
      checkboxInput("vegetarian", "Vegetarian-Friendly Only", value = FALSE),
      checkboxInput("gluten_free", "Gluten-Free Options Only", value = FALSE),
      checkboxInput("has_awards", "Show Only Restaurants with Awards", value = FALSE),
      
      # Dropdown for sorting the table
      selectInput("sort_by", "Sort By:", 
                  choices = c("Rating" = "avg_rating", "Popularity" = "popularity_generic", "Review Count" = "total_reviews_count"), 
                  selected = "avg_rating", width = '100%')
    )
  ),
  
  dashboardBody(
    fluidPage(
      # Indicators row above the map
      fluidRow(
        column(4, 
               h4("Total Restaurants:"),
               textOutput("total_restaurants"),
               hr()
        ),
        column(4, 
               h4("Average Rating:"),
               textOutput("avg_rating"),
               hr()
        ),
        column(4, 
               h4("Restaurants with Awards:"),
               textOutput("restaurants_with_awards"),
               hr()
        )
      ),
      
      # Main content area (Map and Table) in fluidRow
      fluidRow(
        column(12, 
               leafletOutput("restaurantMap", height = 500)
        ),
        column(12, 
               tableOutput("restaurantTable"),
               uiOutput("show_more_button")
        )
      )
    ),
    
    # Add custom CSS styling for a polished look
tags$head(
  tags$style(HTML('
    /* Global Background */
    body, .content-wrapper {
      background-color: #f4f6f9;
      font-family: "Arial", sans-serif; /* Custom Font */
    }
    
    /* Sidebar */
    .sidebar {
      background-color: #2c3e50; 
      color: white;
      padding: 10px 0 10px 15px;
    }

    /* Sidebar Menu Items */
    .sidebar-menu li a {
      color: #1a3d6f !important;  /* Dark Blue Text for menu items */
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .sidebar-menu li a:hover {
      background-color: #1abc9c;
    }

    /* Sidebar Input Fields */
    .form-group label {
      color: #1a3d6f !important;  /* Dark Blue Text for labels */
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    /* Custom styling for dropdown */
    .selectize-input, .selectize-dropdown {
      background-color: #34495E !important;  /* Dark background */
      color: white !important;  /* White text */
      font-size: 14px;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }

    /* Sidebar Header */
    .box-header {
      background-color: #16a085;
      color: white;
    }

    /* Styling for Indicators */
    .indicator-header {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: white;
      background-color: #1abc9c; 
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .indicator-value {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: white;
      background-color: #2980b9; 
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 25px;
    }

    /* Buttons */
    .btn {
      background-color: #1abc9c;
      color: white;
      font-weight: bold;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }

    .btn:hover {
      background-color: #16a085;
      color: white;
    }

    /* Customizing slider */
    .slider-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
    }
  '))
  )
  )
)

# Server
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Reactive expression to get available subcategories based on selected category
  observe({
    selected_category <- input$cuisine_category
    
    if (selected_category == "All") {
      subcategories <- unique(cleaned_paris_restaurants$cuisine_subcategory)
    } else {
      subcategories <- cleaned_paris_restaurants %>%
        filter(cuisine_category == selected_category) %>%
        pull(cuisine_subcategory) %>%
        unique()
    }
    
    # Update subcategories dropdown
    updateSelectInput(
      session, 
      "cuisine_subcategory", 
      choices = c("All", subcategories),
      selected = "All"
    )
  })
  
  # Reactive function to filter data
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    data <- cleaned_paris_restaurants
    
    # Filter by cuisine category
    if (input$cuisine_category != "All") {
      data <- data %>% filter(cuisine_category == input$cuisine_category)
    }
    
    # Filter by cuisine subcategory
    if (input$cuisine_subcategory != "All") {
      data <- data %>% filter(cuisine_subcategory == input$cuisine_subcategory)
    }
    
    # Filter by price level
    if (input$price_level != "All") {
      data <- data %>% filter(price_level == input$price_level)
    }
    
    # Filter by rating range
    data <- data %>% filter(avg_rating >= input$rating[1] & avg_rating <= input$rating[2])
    
    # Filter by vegetarian-friendly
    if (input$vegetarian) {
      data <- data %>% filter(vegetarian_friendly == "Y")
    }
    
    # Filter by gluten-free
    if (input$gluten_free) {
      data <- data %>% filter(gluten_free == "Y")
    }
    
    # Filter by awards
    if (input$has_awards) {
      data <- data %>% filter(awards != "N")
    }
    
    # Sorting by user choice (Rating, Popularity, Review Count)
    data <- data %>% arrange(desc(.data[[input$sort_by]]))
    
    return(data)
  })

  # Render the map with popups
  output$restaurantMap <- renderLeaflet({
    data <- filtered_data()
    leaflet(data) %>%
      addTiles() %>%
      addMarkers(
        ~longitude, 
        ~latitude, 
        popup = ~paste0(
          "<b>Name:</b> ", restaurant_name, "<br>",
          "<b>Rating:</b> ", avg_rating, "<br>",
          "<b>Price Level:</b> ", price_level, "<br>",
          "<b>Cuisine:</b> ", cuisine_category, " - ", cuisine_subcategory, "<br>",
          "<b>Awards:</b> ", awards  
        ),
        clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions()
      )
  })

  # Render the table with filtered data
  output$restaurantTable <- renderTable({
    data <- filtered_data()
    # Show only the top 20 restaurants
    head(data, 20) %>% select(restaurant_name, cuisine_category, cuisine_subcategory, avg_rating, price_level, awards)
  })
  
  # Show the "Show More" button if there are more than 20 restaurants
  output$show_more_button <- renderUI({
    data <- filtered_data()
    if (nrow(data) > 20) {
      actionButton("show_more", "Show More")
    }
  })
  
  # When the "Show More" button is clicked, display more rows
  observeEvent(input$show_more, {
    output$restaurantTable <- renderTable({
      data <- filtered_data()
      data %>% select(restaurant_name, cuisine_category, cuisine_subcategory, avg_rating, price_level, awards)
    })
  })
  
  # Render the total number of restaurants
  output$total_restaurants <- renderText({
    nrow(filtered_data())
  })
  
  # Render the average rating
  output$avg_rating <- renderText({
    avg_rating <- mean(filtered_data()$avg_rating, na.rm = TRUE)
    round(avg_rating, 2)
  })
  
  # Render the number of restaurants with awards
  output$restaurants_with_awards <- renderText({
    nrow(filtered_data() %>% filter(awards != "N"))
  })
}

# Run the app
shinyApp(ui, server)

```
